        13                  REVEREND YOUNG:    Thank you,

        14       Senator.  Let us pray.

        15                  As we gather our legislative

        16       leadership in a spirit of life and hope, we

        17       turn our minds and our hearts toward You,

        18       O God.  Awaken us to Your creative synergy to

        19       answer the hard questions of how can we in

        20       New York State continue to lead our citizens

        21       to a stronger Empire State.

        22                  And we come here on a very cold day

        23       in February in search of understanding what we

        24       can do together.  Let us begin and do this in

        25       the Senate session, an opportunity of not only

         3                  Let this be a place of not only

         4       dialogue but of connection.  Let this be a

         5       place of teaming together that will foster

         6       giving and hope, to bind us together through

         7       this session's trials and tribulations, to

         8       join our mutual interests and our goals for

         9       job growth and needed services.

        10                  Help us, O God, to be joined in a

        11       common purpose of hope and fulfillment so we

        12       will be a circle of expanding, ever-growing

        13       New York State commitment that will result

        14       with a common benefit for one and all.

        15                  Amen.
